title: display issue
symptom: Everything is so small all of a sudden and the glycemic levels are all the way to 600. User wants to get the usual display back.
cause: Very high readings caused xDrip to resize the vertical scale. After a few hours those readings are no longer on the screen so the vertical scale is resized to fit the newer readings.
fix: Use the voice command 'clean up excessive high readings' to resolve this quicker than waiting for 24 hours to pass.
evidence_quote: You had some very high readings at about 15:00. This caused xDrip to resize the vertical scale. After a few hours those readings are no longer on the screen so the vertical scale is resized to fit the newer readings.
